name: Settlement Method 1 Code
definition: Specifies the method used to settle the credit transfer instruction.

INDA.name: Instructed Agent
INDA.definition: Settlement is done by the agent instructed to execute a payment instruction.

INGA.name: Instructing Agent
INGA.definition: Settlement is done by the agent instructing and forwarding the payment to the next party in the payment chain.

COVE.name: Cover Method
COVE.definition: Settlement is done through a cover payment.

CLRG.name: Clearing System
CLRG.definition: Settlement is done through a payment clearing system.
